description: Short identifier for the experiment.
derivation: Assigned by code/scripts/02_prepare_processed_data.R.

allowed_values: study-specific anonymous identifier such as exp1_001
description: Anonymous participant identifier unique within an experiment.
derivation: Generated from Response_ID separately within each experiment; original identifiers are not retained in processed files.

description: Normalized archival trial label used to derive experimental conditions.
derivation: Copied from Trial after whitespace and encoding normalization.

description: Participant naturalness rating for the trial; higher values indicate greater acceptability.
derivation: Copied from Rating in the organized workbook.

description: Participant naturalness rating for the trial; higher values indicate greater acceptability.
derivation: Copied from Rating in the organized workbook.

description: Stimulus-scenario identifier.
derivation: Extracted from the leading integer in trial.

description: Stimulus-scenario identifier for experimental trials.
derivation: Extracted from trial for experimental trials only.

description: Role of the observation in the study design.
derivation: Derived from CT and _F_ markers in trial.

description: Role of the observation in the study design.
derivation: Trials beginning with Filler_ are coded as catch; all others are experimental.

description: Whether the participant is included in analysis.
derivation: TRUE for all Experiment I and II rows; for Experiment III, TRUE when attention_check_failures is less than 2.

description: Reason a participant is excluded from analysis.
derivation: Blank for Experiments I and II; assigned from Experiment III attention-check results.

description: Clause containing negation in the two-clause contrastive construction.
derivation: Neg trials are first_clause; Aff trials are second_clause.

missing_values: blank for catch and filler trials
description: Target adverbial class in experimental trials.
derivation: Derived from Manner, Time, and Red markers in trial.

description: Morphological form of the ideophonic target.
derivation: Assigned as reduplication for ideophone trials.

missing_values: blank for catch and filler trials
description: Whether the continuation matches the target event interpretation.
derivation: Experimental trials containing Loc are mismatch; other experimental trials are match.

allowed_values: match | mismatch | felicitous | infelicitous | direct_object | indirect_object
description: Unified condition label across experimental, catch, and filler observations.
derivation: Uses continuation_type for experimental trials and trial-code markers for catch and filler trials.

description: Constituent-order manipulation distinguishing the two experiments.
derivation: Assigned canonical for Experiment I and noncanonical for Experiment II.

description: Sentence polarity.
derivation: Derived from _Aff_ and _Neg_ markers in trial.

description: Whether the experimental stimulus belongs to the ideophonic or non-ideophonic stimulus set.
derivation: Derived from _Ide_ and NonIde markers in trial.

description: Adverbial form used in an experimental trial.
derivation: Derived from RegMod, Cont, Red, and Cvb markers in trial.

description: Broad semantic class of the target adverbial.
derivation: Temporal adverbs are temporal; manner, reduplication, and converbial forms are manner.

missing_values: blank unless adverb_type is reduplication or converbial
description: Relative degree of morphological integration for ideophonic forms.
derivation: Reduplication is coded low and converbial is coded high.

description: Intended grammaticality of a catch trial.
derivation: Derived from _Gr_ and _UnGr_ markers in trial.

description: Whether an observation constitutes an affirmative catch-trial failure.
derivation: TRUE for an affirmative ungrammatical catch rated above 50 or an affirmative grammatical catch rated below 50.

description: Participant-level count of affirmative catch-trial failures, repeated on every participant row.
derivation: Sum of attention_check_failure within participant.
